title: MLINE-referenced simple LTYPE with ordered string and entity-handle XDATA

scope.source: Runtime-generated DXF; no repository drawing fixture is used or added.
scope.cross_product: Both source encodings were exported to both output encodings.
scope.linetype: EditDash, two simple dash segments [1.0, -0.5], declared length 1.5, source flags 0, alignment 65.

documents.title: DXF Group Codes in Numerical Order Reference
documents.relevant_rule: Group 1000 is a string value in extended data; group 1005 is an entity handle encoded as a hexadecimal string of up to 16 digits.

documents.title: Persistent Inter-Object Reference Handles (DXF)
documents.relevant_rule: XDATA group 1005 handles behave as soft pointers and translate when referenced objects are copied or inserted.

proof.source: Exact ordered physical XDATA groups 1001/1000/1005 bind one bare APPID, the string payload, and the captured code-1005 object identity. The target handle binds to one typed LINE in ENTITIES owned by model space; raw and typed XDATA agree.
proof.output: For both source encodings and both output encodings, staged bytes contain the exact ordered XDATA payload with the translated LINE handle. Fresh import verifies typed order/value, one emitted LINE, model-space BLOCK_RECORD ownership, and the handle reference. Existing LTYPE source binding is also asserted.
proof.failure_retry: Removing the target LINE refuses export and preserves a destination sentinel; restoring it succeeds on the same adapter. A late LINE-handle mutation after APPID emission also refuses atomically; restoring the handle succeeds on the same adapter. Both retries pass exact physical and typed readback.

limits: This receipt covers only one AC1027 simple-LTYPE XDATA sequence, one APPID, one group-1000 value, and one group-1005 soft pointer to a unique model-space LINE in ENTITIES. Other values, orders, target types/sections/multiplicities, list or multi-chunk compositions, APPID metadata, LTYPE schemas and versions remain unqualified.
This is transport and identity-remapping evidence. It does not establish application-specific XDATA meaning, MLINE rendering, recursive document closure, or broader LTYPE support.
